name: tempboard
description: Temporary shareable whiteboard sites — a plugin for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.

plugins.name: tempboard
plugins.description: One command → a temporary collaborative whiteboard with an invite link (edit / view-only), auto-expiring; or an always-on personal board on your own domain. Excalidraw-based, live cursors, LaTeX math, .excalidraw import, MCP server for agents.
